Digimon World 4 is a game I pumped a great deal of time into in my younger years, and I have been thinking about whether or not to do a full LP on it.

For those that do not know, DW4 (Digimon World X in Japan IIRC) is a co-op hack N' Slash + ARPG + Dungeon crawler released during the PS2 era. Critically, it failed; it got about a 6/10 average, 4.3/10 from Gamespot. But consumers liked it, netting a 6.9 on Metacritic. There are two major things people damn the game for: Adverse difficulty, and it being called a clone of Final Fantasy: Crystal Chronicles. Let me just quote IGN to start an argument for the first point:

"Add to [ the high damage of enemies, and low starting health] a low occurrence of health power ups and a lack of automatic saves and a (free) checkpoint system, and you've got a genuine recipe for disaster."

Not to mention, the game has corpse running for EXP (Yes, EXP, not just XP) and currency, but not items. You also require a consumable to be able to pick up your items (They also double as revives in co-op). Something this reminds me of, aside from the lack of free checkpoints or free way to leave the map, is Soulsborne. Just to point out, Demon Souls did not come out until 2008, when DW4 was released in 2005. Tho, the King's Field and Shadow Tower games had been out for a while by that point, of which were made by the same company as the Souls games, Fromsoft.

Writing this out has taught me how there are objective issues with the game, but I feel like putting on some rose-tinted goggles and playing though one of my old favorites.

Now, let's see if my PC will properly run Dolphin, as I have been having major issues with it. Nothing in regards to performance, as my system is incredibly capable, it is just constantly crashes and recently fails to even load the program itself.
